title: Best Movie Thus Far
review: This makes Titanic look pretty pedestrian. Some of the storyline may not be all that original but the storytelling is done so well, you just don't care. Great direction, great effects. This is a movie that you can tell has been painstakingly put together for our enjoyment. Even though it is long you don't notice, as you are so drawn into the story, time just disappears. I would see this one again and again. I'm told it is even better in 3D. Star Trek was my film of the year till I saw this one. Well done James Cameron, keep them coming. This deserves to knock Titanic off the top of the box office records. I don't often bother to make any comments on IMDb but this one is that good. Go see it! Thanks again James for your Christmas present to the movie goers of the world.

title: Enjoyed it, but it's just OK
review: Nice computer generated graphics but that's all there is to the movie. The story is so old and is a mash of so many other themes that it's almost annoying. And the usual, boring, old and tiring theme of the messiah, the chosen one! Please, Matrix pretty much sucked that theme dry (if not the Bible). The other themes are pretty weak too. Yes, we need to live in harmony with nature but nature/environment is neither a living creature nor a totally inert object. What we do to the planet does change things around but the whole Gaia spirit theme has also been beaten to death. Let's see what else smells rotten - the stereo-typical arch-nemesis who simply won't die till the very last scene, corporate greed and stupid humans. Well, we are still around. Right? Then I guess we are not that stupid either! We were not built to conserve or care, those are principles of survival, among many other. Like it or not, we were built to survive and reproduce.

title: One of the best movies ever made.
review:
You're looking for a thrill ride? Cameron's got just what you need.

Honestly, I am not a big fan of watching movies in theaters. But this flick's trailer seemed so nice and something in my mind has told me to go see this movie.

I'll get straight to the point. This movie has sent shivers down my spine. It is absolutely fantastic! Everything in the movie is joined together in perfect harmony: the characters, the graphics and the epic storyline. Each scene is detailed to perfection, the graphics in the movie are jaw-dropping, and the plot... well, to tell you honestly, James is the first director who actually succeeded in making me believe "to the bone" in his unique portrayal of humans vs. aliens.

I bow to James and the crew for making this gem of a movie come to life. This is, by all means, a breakthrough and a standard-setter in the movie industry for many years to come.

If you haven't seen this yet... definitely do so! This movie is simply a masterpiece!

title: The Best Movie I've Ever Seen
review:
This was by far the best movie I've ever seen. Perfect from start to finish - it was a longer movie but felt like it flew by. Incredibly entertaining and moving. The effects are Amazing! Definitely go see the movie in the imax 3D theatres....incredible.

I've already seen the movie twice and it just came out. After leaving the theatre all we could talk about was how we want to be Avatar's...lol. I would recommend this movie to anyone, young, old, male, female. I think this is an enjoyable movie to go see with anyone. As i said earlier the effects are incredible but the acting is also superb. I am not usually a fan of michelle rodriguez, i find her acting to be corny most of the time but the part she played was just the right size and she actually did surprisingly well. Great Film all around! Go see it!

title: An Epic Cinematic Experience
review: Avatar is one of those movies that you walk away from only able to think "wow." The animation and special effects add to the experience greatly, and I can see why James Cameron waited for technology to become more advanced. Avatar would not work without the realistic environments and alien flora and fauna. In addition to the special effects, Avatar has a surprisingly deep and philosophical story. Avatar stands in line with epic movies like Titanic and Star Wars that will be remembered forever due to their exceptional quality. Avatar though, in addition to being amazing on its own, shows what movies are capable of looking like in the future. If you go, and I strongly recommend that you do, see it in 3D. Avatar is, without a doubt, one of the greatest movies of all time.

title: Best Movie Ever?
review:
Let me explain. There isn't any other movie i have watched and then have need to watch it again and again. I've watched it 2 times and i'm going to watch it again today. This movie is so beautiful and overwhelming that i spent the whole running time smiling at his beauty the first time i went on it (so it was in 3D). The second time is when you realize on how flawless the movie is: Environment, characters, emotions, score... you can count everything you appreciate on a movie on this one. I've heard plenty of people complaining about the lack of originality in the script: Hey, if this is Pocahontas then Gladiator is Espartacus.

In the bottom line just say i had never seen anything like this before and i think it will be a long time before we can see something so much "head and shoulders above the rest".

title: A Masterpiece
review:
There is nothing I can say here for this title that it can't say for itself. A picture is worth a thousand words, and given that this is 2 hours and 42 minutes long, words cannot suffice to describe it. That said, let me say a bit before I tell you to watch it if you haven't.

This is without any shadow of a doubt the most visually stunning movie ever made. That it cost so much to make is apparent in every single detail. creativity shines thru in all creatures and the world itself. Tremendously meticulous design is obvious in every aspect, and while it is rather easy at times to see where the artists got their inspiration from -I saw at least 5 instances where I knew the probably source of the design - it all blends into a giant unbelievable world.

The plot is clichéd and mostly predictable, there are few things that you can't see coming, but by the time they do show up the story has managed to grab you so thoroughly that you welcome it and cheer for it as it takes its toll on whoever its victim happens to be.

Only the most apathetic and closed minded of people will fail to feel completely drawn in by the story. This movie makes you forget that you are human, and that's an end of it.

Watch it!

title: A 3D Perfection
review: Wow,amazing,Enthralling, Out of the imagination!!! You can not even describe the feelings when you leave the hall after watching this masterpiece from the legend James Cameron, the sculptor behind Terminator 2 & Titanic.It was one the best experience at the movies i had till date.Simple story executed brilliantly by this genius. Fortunately i booked the show in advance so that i witnessed this MAN MADE MARVEL today . I was trilled by witnessing the gem he has created. The best part of the movie as per me is the whole movie :)> Even from the first minute you just fell into this imaginary thing & it never looses its charm. 3D experience was the cherry on the cake , I have seen UP 3 months back but you can not even compare this with any one, the colors, atmosphere on pandora the greenery , the floating mountains, the battle , I can go on writing each & every thing. I will watch this one again for sure & If you are planing for this one please watch this in Hall & definitely in 3D. Films like this are rarely happen & we must do our part which is to adore people like Cameron & Salute their talent which gives us the one of the best movie experiences one can have.

title: Not to be missed
review: Impressive movie, great special effects. It is a combination of a number of plots. Last of the Mohicans, Dancing with Wolvs, Bravehart to name a few. But is does not matter. You get the idea where the plot is going and what is going to happen. But again it does not matter. Perhaps a bit too heavy handed on the military and mining, but to be expected. The CG was great. Very seamless. Great technical touches in the military machines. I think the casting was done very well. Good choice for the characters. Musical score was great but really did not care for the final song. Just my choice I guess. Take tissues if your a sucker for tearing up in love stories. It was a treat to watch. Do see it in 3D.

title: A boring cliché of too many other movies
review: I went in not expecting very much from Avatar having seen the trailers and reading about the story and of course I was right not to expect much. This movie is a bad Saturday morning cartoon. It's too long and too boring. It rips off too many other movies. If you're going to use a story that has been done too many times i.e Pocohontas, Dances with Wolves, The Matrix,even District Nine you'd better have either a compelling star (that is someone we want to see in this movie) or a twist that is interesting. This movie didn't have either of those things. Also you know I wish that writers would really take a good look at their material before they turn it over for use. The dialog was terrible. Too much narration, you know you're in trouble with a story when you need narration to move the story along. The visuals were nice but we've seen if all before, nothing new here at all. I only gave it a six for the pretty colors.

title: Another landmark in the history of cinema
review:
It's not a usual thing of me to post such comments on a movie but with avatar i had to express my mind in a more literal way.

This movies proves that James Cameron is not only a fine director but also an excellent story teller. All the beauty surrounding the movie environment just takes you to another world and makes you forget everything else for two and a half hours (which for me were not a contribute for an overlenghted movie at all). It is pretty evident that Cameron wants to express his mind about the destructive and selfish nature in the human kind, fact that in the end also builds up for the originality of this masterpiece. Although predictable in some ways, the plot was better than i was expecting.

The CGI, like what i was hoping for, were mind blowing. Nothing as realistic, envolving and perfectly done as avatar, visually speaking, was ever made on a movie.

Again, aside from some predictability in the storyline (which anyway were not even close to a disappointment) Avatar is, hands down, one of the best (if not The best) movies of the year and its a must-see in a theater.

title: Duh !!!
review: I had been wanting to see Avatar since I heard that James Cameron built a camera to make the movie. I have read lots of reviews this past week, and I'm tired of those people that say James took this idea from this movie, and this idea from that movie, and blah - blah - blah. I'm not sure what that has to do with Avatar, but hey - if how he tells his story worked for those other movies he did, then why change the recipe. I really didn't go to this movie about 10-foot tall aliens expecting to see a Shawshank Redemption type movie. I went to see Avatar to experience a state of the art 3D movie, and this movie more than met my expectations. The 3D was absolutely Incredible. You feel like you are in the movie, and that's pretty cool. Every movie shot with the same type camera used in Avatar would be amazing. It's almost three hours long, so you will probably have to use the bathroom, but you really won't want to. If you do take a bathroom break, then you'll probably run there and back -- this movie was that good. You really can't describe this movie. The bad reviews people post are done so by people that don't like James Cameron. Maybe it was his speech where he said he as king of the world that set people off. Do I like him myself - not really, but I do like most of his movies. This has to be one of my favorite of his. All I can say is see Avatar, and see it in 3D.

title: The best movie I have seen!
review: Although this will be a short review, I just want to say a few things....This movie has great actors, phenomenal effects, and the best story line I have seen. I loved this movie, in my opinion it beats 'The Dark Knight' which has been one of my favorites for a while. James Cameron I think I love you....YOU MUST SEE IT NOW, and if so watch it in 3-D. I hate 3-D and the extra price, but I would pay 10X over what I paid to see that movie, it was that good. This isn't the best movie for kids, maybe young adults 15+ in my opinion. The movie has great underlying tones and themes which I will not spoil. On top of this, the movies' length is perfect. It is as long as it needs to be, and the whole thing fits together perfectly. I have to say, this movie has set the bars so high, that I don't think another movie will surpass it in years!

title: Completely Blew My Mind
review: I went in to this movie knowing absolutely NOTHING about the film at all. I knew only that the director was the man who made Titanic and honestly, I wasn't expecting very much from this movie. I had watched the original teaser trailer and thought "Eh, it looks alright maybe I will find time to see it." Last night I took a trip to the 10:30PM film with a few friends of mine and boy was I pleased. I viewed the movie in IMAX 3D and purchased two tickets for 30 DOLLARS over the internet. As the movie began I could not BELIEVE the CG that these guys managed to create, it is flawless. I was just in awe with that itself, but as the story grew I was on the edge of my seat the entire time. The story, acting, and the message behind the movie is just beautiful. My favorite movies before seeing this film are The Shawshank Redemption and The Dark Knight and I have to say Avatar now belongs in the number one spot for me. If you haven't seen this movie you NEED to go as soon as possible! It will make you laugh, cry, and will engulf you into the planet Pandora and by God you should let it!

title: Avatar - the perfect movie!
review:
Avatar is the perfect movie, although calling it a movie is a bit of an understatement. It is an experience.

Avatar transports you to the planet of Pandora, a visually spectacular world that you will dream about visiting. You will not believe the visuals in front of you, particularly if you're watching the 3D version. The spectacular scenery is complimented perfectly by a magnificent story. You will find yourself completely engaged in the film, laughing, crying, and holding your breath along the lovable (and hate-able) characters of the story.

If there's one bad thing to say about Avatar, it's that it will make your normal life seem really mundane. Driving to work everyday will suck a little more as you dream about riding a banshee.

title: Towering and Historic Achievement
review: If you're at all curious about this movie, go see it. A great, moving, and generally well conceived sci-fi movie. Visually beautiful and stunning, the film puts you inside another world. You do forget about the 3D as you're drawn into the story and its fantastically imagined world. The drama and action carry each other well despite the ultimately cliché storyline. Way fun and breathtaking; it's few flaws are completely overwhelmed by magnificent movie making and story telling. Touches on everything from corporate totalitarianism, militarism, genetic medicine for disabilities, global warming and ecology to Gaia, neural networks, Native Americans and allusions to George Bush. Not to be missed by anyone interested in the art of film.

title: Special effects - Awesome. Story - Shallow and Cliché.
review:
I was very hyped for the opening of Avatar, expecting a high caliber movie. As an avid follower of 3d titles I was especially looking forward to this movie. In short I thought the creativity in making Pandora come to life breathtaking but found the story full of Cliché.

To me it was evident that Cameron had all the new tools of the trade to make Avatar, but just because a director has all the tools to envision a story does not mean he should. Am I saying Avatar should not have been made? No. But what I was surprised about Avatar was the extensive creative work put into a story that seemed to lack any kind of heart and had little character development. Why was the head of security a complete psycho with a destructive bent? Why did the company mining in a far off galaxy lack any kind of human ethic? Why would the military be a part of this operation? I could go on and on.

The 3d part of the movie was OK at best. I feel that movies that are going to utilize 3d should really use that aspect to "immerse the audience" by exploiting the 3d technology. With Avatar there were moments where I felt like the experience would have been the same with or without 3d. The depth to the 3d was shallow and not very intense.

Without being too critical I will finish by saying that I was entertained, and that's what I payed for with Avatar. Was my mind or heart provoked much? Not really. I would see this one at the theater but not own it in my personnel collection.

title: Literally Breathtaking!
review:
Saw Avatar today at the IMAX (I think Dubai only has one...) in 3D.

It was interesting that afterwards, we went for dinner and both the wife and I sat there in total silence while we ate and once we had finished we both said the same thing.

That planet, those people and those events happened! We've just lived through it.

It is possibly the most immersive film I've ever seen. It is literally breathtaking.

The plot is the weakest part - it has been done before with Dancing with Wolves and a number of other films - but I realised early on that it only adds to the experience. You can use the part of your brain that would normally be used to work out the twists and turns of a thriller and devote 100% to simply living in that world with those characters and experiencing what is going on.

There isn't a huge amount of interaction between the CGI bods and the 'real' world but when there is, it is completely seamless - there's a bit right at the end where it does happen and it is simply 'real' and full of emotion.

James Cameron is a director that I rate up there with Ridley Scott - they don't make bad films. OK, some of them may not be masterpieces but I'm yet to see a bad one from either of them. Titanic, while it may be a bit soppy, is still a brilliant piece of cinema and this is how Avatar is.

I usually walk out of the cinema with a view that it was a good/OK/bad film etc... This, and this will sound strange, this made feel privileged to be allowed into their world, I found it that involving. When I think of the film now, sat at home, it's more like my own memories rather than a snapshot of a certain scene.

I will be going to see it again on Thursday and I'm looking forward to spending even more time looking around and losing myself for a few hours.

9.5/10

title: Awesome movie!
review:
Hi My name is Zahra, I am a 3D Geek and comic book fan and I was so excited about the avatar movie. I am of East African Origin and felt a connection with Neytiri but I could swear the characters facial expression, way of speaking, mannerism was that of an African actress I have seen on TV before, It is totally African. I was quite surprised to see that Neytiti was played by Zoe Saldana. If all of it was her then she is a great great actress, she was incredibly believable.

Great Work! I really enjoyed watching it and I hope The comic book will be on his way soon with more adventures as well as the video game.

Love it Keep up the good work, we should have more comic book based movie like that.

title: Just Fabulous
review: I will not spend too many words. This movie set the bar for the next decade. A marvelous masterpiece, a visual stunning experience. A colorful journey, incredible special effects and a beautiful message delivered to the audience. Is it too much to say perfect? Maybe, but it is very close to be such perfect movie. James Cameron never stops to amaze with his ideas and mastery. The actors are doing just excellent and I saw with pleasure an ever young Sigourney Weaver (at the beginning she was coming out from the capsule as the Alien/Aliens movies). Love the blue skin of the inhabitants of Pandora as well as the the great creativity and fantasy used to design any single creature of the Flora's and Fauna's amazing world. 10/10 enough to say.

title: Avatar is High Art.
review:
Avatar in 3D is most likely the most beautiful thing I have ever seen... I'm not referring to films here. It is absolutely overwhelming visually. It's really quite hard to find words. Inevitably, some will find weaknesses, which is predictable. However, this movie is in no way deserving of any criticism.

It's ironic to me, just hours before going to see Avatar, I was discussing with a friend the lack of new, really good stories coming out of Hollywood at the moment. It seems to me, all of the entertaining films as of late, are remakes of classic ideas... I stand corrected. It's nice to know truly great film-making is alive and well!

Amongst all that's going on in the world at the moment, I urge you to take a break. Go see Avatar and celebrate a little of what is so inspiring and truly amazing about the creative potential of humanity.

title: What a Way to end A Great Decade in Cinema
review:
As i sat in the theatre i was not as excited as i wished i could have been. 3 Hours Later and the credits rolled i walked out with nothing but pride knowing that James Cameron who has been on hiatus for 12 years making crappy documentaries still has the magic to make great entertaining films.

Avatar is about Jake Sully (Sam Worthington) who is called to Pendorra to take his twin brother's place in a program where he turns into a creature called a Na'vi which are savage creatures which live on the planet.As Jake bonds with the creatures in his new form,he soon realises what the human's intentions are and decides to help this race in defending their planet.

To start off.This film is spectacular viewing.The effects are wonderful and do not really need 3-D to make the viewing amazing although i hear 3-D is wonderful.I thought the creatures were wonderful creations which makes you wonder how did James Cameron make these fascinating creatures.Acting is also brilliant.Sam Worthington does a great performance as both a human and a Na'vi.Sigorney Weaver is also very good as the scientist.

There are not really any bad things that i notices but apparently the plot is similar to Dances with Wolves.Well i don't think there were major or eye spotting problems.I thought the story was wonderful and there were no slip ups.

So Avatar is maybe Cameron's finest work in my opinion.If a sequel is made then i will welcome it with open arms.

title: FANTASTIC, entertaining, beautiful
review: If I could shake Mr. Cameron's hand I would. This film has it all...REALLY has is all. Take the family, heck even grandma will love this film. I was enthralled, captivated....so many other words that don't do this film justice. I could have done with out the evil humans killing another planet bit but there is truth behind it. Human greed and corporate lust for wealth and power without individual responsibility is a real thing but that is a whole other post. YOU MUST SEE THIS FILM!!! I will be seeing it again in Portland IMAX 3D when we go up for Christmas. Oh yes I said it. Merry Christmas and enjoy the movie.

title: James Cameron makes a whole new world with Avatar
review: I just got back from the theater and saw James Cameron's "Avatar" . Prior to this, I thought that the movie was going to be some lame sci-fi ripoff of "Dances With Wolves". I was wrong. The film completely blew me away and left me in awe when it ended. Cameron takes us to a whole new world, Pandora, and does a hell of a job presenting it. The world contains a variety of multiple and diverse species. Most of all, we're introduced to the natives, the Na'vi, and their culture. I thought the acting was pretty good. Yes, the film does contain some cheesy dialogue, but you can't let that ruin this film. It's truly a cinematic experience of a lifetime. You won't be disappointed.

title: Avatar - in one word: MAGNIFICENT
review:
Heading into this movie, I did a bit of research, such as reading other's reviews & watching the behind the scenes on HBO. Needless to say, my expectations got built up a bit. A lot of the time when I get my hopes up, the movie ends up letting me down. Avatar delivered on all of my hopes and THEN SOME!

I am not going to delve into the story, as you should have a good idea what happens in this movie after reading other's reviews. What I will say is that this is one of those movies that totally immerses you into it. You definitely feel for the natives and it gives you an interesting perspective of what others may think of US interests/intervention overseas. I am not trying to make a political statement, but it is important to bring up nonetheless.

The world of Pandora is breathtaking. No matter how bizarre the creatures, how jaw-dropping the terrain, or how magical the place may seem, it is all believable. You can tell how much dedication was placed into making everything as detailed as possible.

The movie was completely satisfying, from beginning to end. My best advice for any of you wishing to see this is this: sit back, relax, and allow yourself to be drawn into the experience (and if you're willing to shell out a couple of extra bucks, watch it in 3D!).

title: Astonishing Cinema
review: Read many comments in here before seeing this and they were spot on. This film is so beautiful and stunning it defies belief. Felt to me like seeing a film hundreds of years in the future. Story line is great and the Nav'i capture your heart very strongly. Avatar has taken movie creatures and special effects many, many steps forward. Some people have likened this to Dances With Wolves and there is a simple parallel but it is a great understatement. Telling folks about this verbally I simply say "words cannot convey." It is fairly long but so engrossing that one does not notice. It is so incredibly good, I will be shocked if it does not reach top 20 of all time in here. Saw it without the 3D and imagine that in 3D it would just simply blow the audience's brains clean out of their skulls. Indeed this film is a landmark and a new one to beat. Cannot imagine that happening anytime soon. Bravo, bravo, bravo!

title: Welcome back James Cameron
review:
Mr. Cameron, congratulations.

The great-minded mixing of reality and fiction makes this piece of art the best of it's kind at this moment and it will be really hard to reach such perfection again.

I was watching the film with my girlfriend in 3D theater, and I was so impressed, that theater personnel almost begged me to leave the room. I was only try to see all the credits and how many collaborators were needed to draw something as big as it is Avatar.

My hobby is 3D art and I know how hard is to achieve those crazy small details like fly-like creatures flying in forefront, and so on.

The action is all in Cameron's style, and i liked it, I missed it.

Through the whole movie I was asking myself, was story a big message for the world's greatest economy leaders to prevent global pollution and consecutive warming, what in the end could lead to such actions, or was it just a bit of creativity delight.

title: James Cameron Matches God in Creativity and Imagination!!!
review:
I watched the trailer of "Avatar" just a week before and i was impressed but when i saw the movie in IMAX-3D...I was Speechless...i wish the movie had never ended...till yesterday "LOTR" and "King Kong(2005)" - both by "Peter Jackson" and his own "WETA" were my best Special Effects Movies...but from today its "Avatar"..."James Cameron" proved that he is one of the top 3 filmmakers of Hollywood along with "Peter Jackson" and "Spielberg"...

Watch Avatar not just because reviews are good, not just because it is directed by James Cameron, not just because it has amazing special effects, not just because its one of the most expensive movies.....Watch "AVATAR" because It's an Out Of The World Experience!!!...and Please if possible, watch it in IMAX-3D if you want to have the complete experience and to give justice to the Special Effects...

"Avatar" makes me feel Why Earth is so Dull????!!!!

"James Cameron", you Matched God in Creativity and Imagination!!!

title: simply amazing
review:
I went to see this film earlier today and I was blown away. Cameron has created a new type of cinema. The plot was OK but I spent two and a half hours gawking at the screen.

The entire movie is one special effects scene after another, but it is so visually crisp and clean that the user is brought into the world of Pandora. An Oscar is definitely on the way, and the music sets up the atmosphere of the film perfectly. so what if its a futuristic version of dances with the wolves. It more than makes up for it in so many other areas. Would recommend too all, even those who don't usually enjoy sci-fi films. 10/10

title: Exceeded my expectations!
review: Probably the best movie of 2009,super incredible,i had a feeling this was gonna be good but damn..it was good,the concept and story line is the basic story of man who wishes to explore where life is right and uninterrupted and take what he wants for of course money and power.This is a story that can be found throughout the history,'the Americas,Africa'but of course the film adds a lot more to it,and simply takes it to a whole nother level,James Cameron is a GENIUS!The cgi and effects where unlike anything i have ever seen and this film is bound to change the way we look at movies.The 'Na,vies' where all rely cool and each had specific personalities and where all likable,the scenery alone with the wildlife and everything was amazing,siguoerny weaver and Sam Worthington were excellent,i liked Sam in this movie better then in T-salvation,he did an excellent job.The long war scene at the end i find made up for the beginning of the film which i found started off alil slow,there where a few scenes that i also thought where abit predictable,but honestly,i think it just put everything together well enough,even my step mom who normally doesn't like movies like this was stunned,id recommend it for anyone,a lot of humorous scenes,good drama,it had good things going no dought,9 on 10

title: The best movie of the year if not decade!
review: I just can't tell enough good words about James Cameron's AVATAR. It's not state of the art movie - IT IS ART itself! What you see in the trailer can barely scratch the surface of the movie and while the plot seems to be predictable the whole realizm and beauty of this movie makes me simple cry!!!! The whole world of PANDORA seems so much realistic that you literally live the screen. Every tiny bit of pixel is alive - it's pure and it's all love! Bravissimo! This is the best movie I seen in year and I will go to see it again and again! Personally I won't be surprised if it will go for Oscars not just for visual effects but for a BEST film and director too...

title: Definitely One Of The Best Movies Of This Decade
review:
How can you begin to describe the pure amazingness in side of this film?

How can you possibly deny the super-saturated special effects and mind blowing animation?

There is just about nothing that I can pick out in the movie that was by any remote means sub-standard, or wrong.

I can't complain with the camera angles, the soundtrack (which was flawless and sync'd up with the movie amazingly well), or the great acting, yet, that's just covering up the boring and technical aspect of it.

The story was by far one of the best pieces of work I have ever seen. Yet, a little clichéd, and a little predictable, I found myself eating up every last bit of it.

Not only did I fall for the story, but for the characters, and the emotion that it put into me. You really feel like you are in that world, and the fact that it's in 3-D blurs the line between you sitting in the movie theatre, and being in the film itself.

Definitely see it in IMAX, definitely see it in 3-D, anything else is blasphemy.

title: By the end, you'll be playing for the blue side!
review:
I won't state the obvious, you've read it in all the other comments; this is an amazing visual film!! You simply *cannot* tell this is CGI!! You cannot! Of course to be honest, the fact that this is an alien world with nothing to compare it with, helps Cameron and I have a suspicion that if they were trying to re-create Earth and human actors, the end result wouldn't be so believable. But nevertheless, Cameron actually *brings* you into Pandora and you will simply fall in love with this world and it's natives, the Na'vi.

Lots of commenters have said that the story/plot was stale and old. Yes, the plot has been done before... the foreigner (human in this case) falls in love with the native ... Pocahontas anyone? But in the end... so what!? Seriously, how many stories *haven't* been told? What exactly would you consider original? This is the post-modern age... we've seen it all; the romance, the gory, the idiotic and now movie makers are focusing on scaring us by not showing anything... playing with our psyche because our *eyes* have seen it all. Except Pandora... you haven't seen anything like that. I loved the story... yes it was Pocahontas all over again in another setting but so what? I think the simple story worked for this film. I really left the viewing with a smile on my face. I didn't have to ponder over difficult questions and I could focus on the visual Heaven Cameron created. Not that this film is without it's moral lessons... I was kind of ashamed I am human and really wanted to turn blue.. at the end I was playing for the blue side and so will you... If this is the future of cinema, well I can't wait for what comes next... because I tell you, everything else after this, kinda feels stale!

title: It Will Blow the Ewya out of you!!!
review: i was lucky enough today to see Avatar in 3D and let me tell you folks, this is as close to perfect as you will get! everything was outstandingly done and it makes the viewer feel like not one detail was left out. the visual aspect of it was simply unbelievable and i teared up after viewing the beautiful scenery of Pandora. this movie will make you think " IF ONLY THIS WERE REAL ". the Sound effects were stunningly real and it all wraps up into a satisfying once in a life time experience, like your first kiss. It was worth every red cent and i recommend this movie to the young and old who have any sense of an imagination. WATCH AVATAR!!

title: Without question
review:
Without question this is the greatest action film, and the greatest science fiction film ever. For a long, long, LONG time I thought nothing could ever compare to Terminator 2. Well, if anyone could surpass it, it would be the man that made the original film, and that's what James Cameron has done.

Anyone complaining about no character development has NOT seen the film. An hour and 50 min of the film is spent on ONLY character development. These are some of the most well rounded and in depth characters I've seen in a film. Sigourney Weaver literally breaths her part, as does Stephen Lang, and man, what a great bad guy he makes. In fact to call this an action/science fiction is pretty dishonest. 50% of the film is character drama.

The visuals are indeed the best ever. The war scenes near the end are simply stunning. The Na'vi I felt looked a bit off at first, but they fit perfectly in the alien world made for them.

The action of the film is mind blowing, and the second half of the film will likely cause you to stand up and cheer. It was very hard for me not to.

By the end, the entire theater applauded, I have never been to a showing of a film and seen that before, but my God this film earned it.

Stunning sites, great action, and really some of the best acting in a film I've ever seen. Everyone in this film should get an Oscar. EVERYONE In short, you must see this film, and if you've seen it already, SEE IT AGAIN!

title: What a Movie !!
review: To just say AVATAR is 1 of the finest movie of the decade or so wud b an understatement. As a Cameron fan we all waited very eagerly for more than 12 years after Titanic. Now what do we get to see after this long hiatus? Ans : A Brilliant piece of work. As always like his prev ones it has something for all movie buffs. I wouldn't say this is the best of Cameron either, but what makes THIS venture so unique is the gr8 visual experience, direction, fantastic imagination, characters & most importantly the story packs a subtle message for all about how important it is to protect our nature and conserve our fragile Eco systems (Flora & Fauna). All in all a SUPERB MOVIE & in our MUMBAI parlance "PAISA VASOOL".

title: Best movie ever!
review: I think that the concept, the story and the (for us) extra-terrestrial 'flora and fauna' are phenomenally well thought of, imagining that a human being wrote it. I am speechless! The cgi effects are very good as well, I have to say, perhaps because I am still in euphoria :p, it's the best movie ever made! There is just one minor problem, a really really small one; through the video recordings that the main character makes, you can see at what time the movie is situated. And I think it was 2154 or something, which I believe is quite early for such a scenario to take place. For the rest, Best movie ever made!  it will undoubtedly set new records. It has breakthrough and newer-before-thought-of ideas. this surely deserves a couple of Oscars and other awards;)!

title: If your don't enjoy this movie, I guess nothing from 2009 has.
review:
All I've read was either A+ reviews, or a F reviews.

Heres the break down, some people graded it A cause they've been spoon fed an opinion, others rate it an F just so they can get their 15 seconds of attention and undermine the big hype of this movie.

Well, does the hype live up to the movie? The hype was an understatement. This movie is amazing. I walked in afraid that it wouldn't be that great and that it was a '2012' in the making, where it looks awesome but its only for looks). Wrong, this movie is amazing! THE STORY IS NOT PERFECT! Its not even 100% original! BUT and this is a big but, Cameron and crew have done something no one has (cliche, I know) how many movies are integrated in live action with CG animation? Okay, a lot, but none on this level of grandeur.

I could swear they had to have filmed a majority of this in a real jungle, but nope. Not one frame is a real jungle. The VFX in this movie is extremely well done! That is not a lie! And all this hype of 3D, it actually is worth it.

Is it real 3D?? No way Jose, in fact if it was, it would've robbed the movie of its story and VFX. The 3D aspect makes its very suttle but for first timers its amazing. Think of it as depth of field 3D style, it honestly looks like your in a room looking at people, while at the same time not making you lose focus on the movie to "o0o" and "awe" at this or that.

Movie is well done, the story is good, the acting is great, the world and environments are UNBELIEVABLE. I will most likely watch it again if a group of friends ask, and I have never watched the same movie in theaters twice, SO...that says something.

Its worth the time to watch! Even if you wind up hating it, it is a must see for yourself. One thing will astonish you at least. Worth matinée and full price, I highly suggest IMAX 3D if you could careless for price.

title: One of the best kids movies ever made
review:
Let's look at this movie for what it is, a children's/teen's movie. And it is a great one at that. Every 8 year old boy is going to love the cool air ships and military weaponry. Every girl will swoon over the simple love story at the heart of this movie. Both will adore the creatures, powerful and beautiful, vicious and tame. I

In fact, the critters and creatures are toy marketing gold! It is without a doubt the Star Wars of the new millennium. Ground breaking visuals, simple but effective storyline and a watershed moment for movie making with endless marketing potential for everything from action figures to pyjamas.

The world Pandora is so complete and awe inspiring that if you look closely you can see the future with a couple awards, a dozen books, a hundred toys and games, a thousand inspired future artists and film makers, a million children begging for the merchandise and a billion or so in box office receipts.

If you expect an complex, engaging story aimed at the thirty something crowd, you will be disappointed. If you look at this from the perspective as it was intended, a children's fairytale, you will walk away wholly satisfied and eager for more.

title: Incredibly beautiful
review:
What a beautiful experience! I was told that the story is simple and disappointing, but to me it was extremely well done. It is exactly right for the occasion: present a completely new kind of cinema to an audience as big as possible. The beauty of the images is overwhelming, the characters are completely believable and not shallow at all.

My only complaint is that there is too much Aliens-like violence and too little time for just experiencing the strangeness of an alien world. My son is 11 years old. Just a little bit too young to see the film. I would have loved to give him this experience.

OK, the story is not the most original I've seen. But there is so much detail and the story is so effective and moving that I don't care. I laughed, I cried, I was angry. I felt every emotion I was supposed to feel. Including the joy of feeling your feet again... I can't imagine a story that would make this film better than it is now.

One thing that should be mentioned here is the influence of WETA, the makers of "Lord of the Rings". They added that special "unamerican" feel that made the LOTR trilogy so successful, and will do the same for the Avatar franchise.

Surely, now that the world of Avatar is established, we can expect more... much more! What a time to be alive! WOW!

review:

title: UNBELIEVABLE experience!!! sets new benchmark..
review:
Just back from seeing Avatar in 3D. This movie sets new benchmark for science fiction cinema. The movie is a breathtaking visual treat and admirable even if not a 3D. The life forms and their details in Pandora takes your breath away. The flying scenes, hanging mountains, aerial war scenes ...and you just cant resist saying a big .WOW!!.You need all the superlatives you have to describe the visual treat. All the credit should go to James Cameron for all his effort in putting this movie together. The story line has some similarity with The Dances With Wolves by Kevin Kostner. The movie has all the necessary elements..Fiction, Action, love, heroism and points to the greed of Human race.

This movie is a must watch and sure deserves Oscar .. more than one

title: This movie is beyond doubt a bench mark movie
review: I just finished viewing this film. The acting is the best, the special effects are the best. The plot and everything else. This movie changes everything--opens a new era--this is the benchmark. The very best. I was especially taken by the color of the planet and its animals, everything was so alive and so believable. I had to keep reminding myself that it was a movie. The 3D effects were so much better than what I expected and watching a 2D movie won't be the same ever again. I rather suspect that in the near future all movies will be 3D or else not able to compete.Its hard to get the special effects and the plot on an equal footing but no problem here, its all good. This film is the gold standard and of that I am sure.

title: "Just relax and let your mind go blank"
review:
That's really all you need to do to enjoy this movie. Don't go into it assuming masterful storytelling. Don't go in hoping for a thinking man's script. In fact, don't even expect to see a film in the traditional sense. Because truly, Avatar is more of an experience than a film, and the experience is one of the most entertaining, most impressive ones you'll ever take. James Cameron is a genius, and out of all the movies he's made - Aliens, Terminator, and Titanic - this is the one I believe he will be most remembered for. The bar has been set, and a milestone in movie-making has been reached.

Note: If there were ever an excuse to watch a movie in 3D, this would be it. Even better, watch it in IMAX... I promise, the experience is worth it. Have fun.

title: Avatar, a movie for the ages
review: I don't even know where to begin. This movie completely blew me away. First I will talk about the visuals. The visuals are unbelievable. The world that is created in this movie looks absolutely beautiful. The background details are very detailed and the Facial expressions on the aliens (Navi) are very realistic. On top of amazing visuals, the music is epic and really draws you in. Acting was top notch and the characters were believable. Everything about this movie draws you in. It takes you away into a different world and makes it seem real, makes you care about what's happening in the movie. It was a solid movie all around. It's a must see movie. Talking about it does not do it justice. Go see it!!!

title: Awesome film
review: Don't really care if I'm merely echoing other peoples views. It's enough for me that I feel compelled to put this view out there. I've read the official critics reviews in the Times and the Daily Telegraph and the Daily Mail and my only response to all of them is that they've been in the job too long. (The Daily Mail's Chris Tookey even had the gall to refer to it as Dances with Smurfs without attributing the description to South Park) This film is a masterpiece - mildly derivative, yes but how many films are truly original any more? It was worth the hype and it crossed genres in so many ways. My wife, who is an unapologetic chick-flick lover, thought it was the best film of the year, if not the decade. It wasn't over-long, it created a believable, stunning and imaginative new world and the story was involving. Not interested in faulting it. Hope it achieves similar numbers to Titanic and that the reviewers who gave it average reviews go back to giving rave reviews to films no one likes or watches about lesbian care workers having crises of conscience on bleak northern tower blocks.

title: Simply Amazing
review:
James Cameron has done it again. He has pushed the boundaries of movie making beyond anything we've seen before. This movie lets you explore the amazing new world that Cameron has given birth to. Beautiful, interesting, alluring, breathtaking, are just a few of the adjectives that can be used to describe this world. Visuals are superb and the 3D aspect of the movie only adds to that. Wonderful cast and great acting. The originality, attention to detail and completeness of this film are a real privilege to witness. It will keep you hooked through the entire feature and a great ending that will not disappoint.

This movie is easily one of the best of the decade, a must-see masterpiece. In 2 words: Simply Amazing.

title: Mind Blowing Experience
review:
This is from one of the best SFX movies ! I watched this Epic movie yesterday, at Navi Mumbai aka New Bombay's Fame Cinema and it was a wonderful experience. The imagination, CGI + Sound Effects are something to be experienced first hand.

As in any typical Sci-Fic movie, the storyline is not the USP of the movie, nor does James Cameron promises that. Like 'The Terminator', this one will over a period of time 'grow' over the audience and win many hearts + $$$.

Only, losers & morons will not appreciate this Epic which took 4 years in making.

title: Thank you, James Cameron
review:
Okay, I'm your typical 20-year-old dude. I watch a lot of horror movies. I've never ever, not once in my life, felt like crying during a movie, not even when I was a kid, and no, not even for The Lion King. But Avatar got to me like no movie ever did. It was such mind-numbingly beautiful and poignant experience that I felt awed just by being in the theater.

It's embarrassing and strange for me to even say this, but when I got home, Avatar had me in tears. I may write a coherent comment later, when I have the words.

James Cameron, you humble us all.

title: Very 'influenced' and filled with 'cliches' but still a great movie with the best visuals ever seen!!!
review:
I must say that even though i really wanted to watch this movie,i still expected it to suck!I think that in these days,big budget movies are usually being eaten by great visuals.By that i mean that visuals oftenly distract you from holes in the script.And i can't say that,that's not the question with this movie too.Avatar is definitely not a movie that shows us something new in the way of storytelling or even the general idea!It's pretty obvious that it's been highly influenced by such movies as Dances With Wolves!To be completely honest,the only thing that's flawless in this movie are visuals!And they are so,so great.Especially in 3-D.But still,i really can't find a reason that would make me hate this movie.Maybe that's because i didn't expect it to be as good as James Cameron said it will be,i don't know.

Avatar is a very interesting and tense movie with a predictable plot and bad character development!And even though i gave it nine,i still must admit that it DOESN'T DESERVE IT.At least not for what was said it will be because if you judge it by that,you will definitely be disappointed.It's a classic story with a classic ending and everything else except for the revolutionary visuals!But it's still very,very enjoyable to watch.And even though the characters were very shallow in a way that they're not complexed enough or maybe even at all,they're still quiet lovely and interesting and you will definitely care for them.Just as for the entire Na'vi civilization which is pretty well described in the movie but also obviously influenced by the native Americans or should i say indians!

I can find a large number of mistakes that this movie has.I can also name at least ten movies that obviously influenced James Cameron to make this one.But i wont.Instead i'm just gonna take it for what it is and enjoy it's thousand times already seen but still beautiful story!This movie is definitely my recommendation to everyone.Just don't expect it to be what James Cameron said it will be because you might and probably will be disappointed.Except for the visuals!

title: Avatar- non 3d 35mm showing

I travelled down to the cinema the early hours of today to see the regular non 3d showing of this film. First of all, see this film, one of the best this year, and I have seen about 80 films. No thank you, I have no idea why anyone could think a 1 year old's crayon scrawl put on screen on this or any other film could be worth sitting through or paying RAPE cinema prices for, avoid the 3d films!

title: Worst Movie Ever
review: If I had the choice to give this movie a zero I would have. James Cameron has lost his touch since the second Terminator movie. His movies since have achieved success based solely on how much was spent to make them. With Titanic a movie which was hyped to the moon and won 11 Oscars and was the biggest box office success ever sucked chef's salty balls lol.
